$comment: Actor-free one-shot deployment of the Ice Mirror shield body. The transparent equal-sided hex screen expands from the actor center, holds at full size, then fades at full size without collapsing.
name: Ice Shield - Mirror Screen Deploy
description: A transparent, cold mirror screen with an equal-sided hexagonal silhouette, a ground-pointing lower corner, soft frost haze, and one clean outer rim. It grows from the actor center, holds fully expanded, then fades without collapsing.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: Render at 512px, then downsample to the 128px gameplay cell. At 12 fps, the 42-frame one-shot lasts 3.5 seconds: expansion reaches full size at frame 9, holds through frame 27, then smoothly fades over 15 frames at full scale.

anchor.$comment: Centered on the protected actor; the actor is omitted from the sprite.

layers.note: A low-contrast translucent sapphire frost haze uses the dedicated MirrorHexScreen texture without interior seams or spokes. The equal-sided body expands from center, holds, and fades while staying full size.
One clean regular-hex frost rim with equal sides and angles; no inner ring or spokes. The cold cyan emission is translucent.

knownIssues: The pale frost rim may lose contrast over bright game backgrounds; review it at gameplay scale before approval.
